Pipeline Inspection

Ensuring reliable energy resource delivery

Pipeline Inspection Solution
Overview

Solution overview

Pipelines are the safe and most critical infrastructure for long-distance transportation of oil, gas, and petroleum products. These energy arteries demand constant monitoring and rapid maintenance, especially in remote areas.

Coloron’s advanced solution uses smart technologies and products to enable efficient, intelligent inspections, ensuring the secure and continuous flow of energy resources.

Scenario 1 of 4

Pipelines

Challenges

Crude oil and natural gas travel through various types of pipelines from collection points to distribution stations. Long-distance pipelines present several challenges, including:

Delayed leak and theft detection

Pipeline routes span thousands of kilometers across uninhabited wilderness. Unreported pinhole leaks, pipe ruptures, and illegal hot-tapping can cause severe product loss and environmental damage before detection.

High costs due to remote locations

Traversing deserts, alpine mountains, and dense boreal forests for routine visual patrols incurs exorbitant logistics expenses, helicopter charters, and extreme safety risks for patrol personnel.

What we offer

Coloron offers sensing solutions and solar-powered products for efficient pipeline monitoring.

Intrusion & Theft protection

Coloron’s vibration fiber optic sensing solution uses buried optical fibers along pipelines for real-time detection. The optical fibers cover long distances and accurately identify the types and locations of anomalies. It also integrates with Coloron’s cameras for site monitoring.

  • Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) detects excavation, vehicle passage, and footsteps up to 50 km per channel
  • Intelligent AI algorithms filter out railway or roadway interference to prevent false alarms
  • Automatic PTZ camera slew-to-cue locks onto the exact intrusion coordinate with instant visual verification

Remote inspection

Solar-powered cameras are perfect for remote pipeline environments with limited power and network access. These cameras provide continuous 24/7 monitoring, capture high-resolution images via PTZ presets, and enable managers to respond quickly to any threats.

  • Fully autonomous power supply with high-efficiency photovoltaic panels and smart low-temperature lithium cells
  • 4G / 5G / Satellite broadband transmission streams high-definition video even in cellular dead-zones
  • Scheduled preset patrols automatically monitor valve vaults, river crossings, and critical cathodic protection stations
